configurePresets.name: here
configurePresets.description: This machine: the pinned MSVC, SDK, CMake, Ninja and CPython, from a shell vcvars64.bat -vcvars_ver=14.44.35207 set up; the interpreter from QIVEN3_PYTHON or a user preset

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.displayName: Release with debug information, MSVC: the build the full suite runs on

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: /fsanitize=address on every target; the runtime's DLL goes beside each test binary; v3's allocators on the system heap; the failing countdown

configurePresets.name: fuzz
configurePresets.description: /fsanitize=address and libFuzzer's coverage options on every target, /fsanitize=fuzzer on the fuzz targets alone, and /INCREMENTAL:NO; builds the fuzz targets

configurePresets.name: structure
configurePresets.description: Includes: Ninja consumes the compiler's /showIncludes, so the build reruns each core source's compile_commands.json command with /showIncludes into a file. Names: dumpbin /symbols of each object. Link edges: CMake's --graphviz output. The structure tests read these files.

configurePresets.name: stack
configurePresets.displayName: The frame bound, MSVC: /analyze's C6262 at 4,096 bytes, an error
configurePresets.description: /analyze /analyze:stacksize4096 over v3's own sources, by stack.ruleset: C6262 alone

configurePresets.name: analysis
configurePresets.displayName: Static analysis, MSVC: the Core Guidelines checker, then clang-tidy
configurePresets.description: /analyze with EspXEngine.dll and analysis.ruleset over v3's own sources; then the target qiven3_tidy runs clang-tidy, by .clang-tidy, over compile_commands.json's sources of src/ and tests/support/

configurePresets.name: nohal
configurePresets.description: QIVEN_HAL off: no qiven3_hal, no HAL fake and no H case but H6

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: CI, a runtime evaluation on the runners' latest images: the image's compiler, CMake and Ninja, unpinned, QIVEN_PIN_TOOLS off; every CI preset shares one build directory, which the fake test preset reads; the interpreter from QIVEN3_PYTHON, which the workflow sets

configurePresets.name: linux-plain
configurePresets.displayName: CI on ubuntu-24.04, the image's g++, no sanitizer: the frame bound and the clean-binaries check
configurePresets.description: Uninstrumented, so -Wframe-larger-than=4096 is on, which every sanitizer preset leaves out; the workflow checks its binaries for the checkout's and the runner's paths

configurePresets.name: linux-msan
configurePresets.displayName: CI on ubuntu-24.04, the image's clang++: MemorySanitizer, a trial, against libc++ built under it from its own LLVM release
configurePresets.description: QIVEN3_LIBCXX names the prefix of a static libc++, libc++abi within it, built with -fsanitize=memory, which the workflow builds; the flags go in CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS and CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS, so that CMake's own probes compile and link against it; -stdlib=libc++ on the link line alone, since under -nostdinc++ a compile leaves it unused, which -Werror fails
